top.title: UAE Property: 'Can my tenant legally list my apartment as a holiday rental without my consent?'

A neighbour recently contacted me because different people appear to be entering the apartment every few days with suitcases. top.impact_reason: Clarifies landlord rights and tenant regulations for short-term rentals.
top.headline: Tenant Unlawfully Lists Dubai Marina Flat as Holiday Home
top.summary: A Dubai Marina landlord discovered their tenant was illegally listing the rented apartment on holiday home websites without consent. Such unauthorized subletting violates standard tenancy agreements.
top.why: It addresses legal obligations and tenant restrictions regarding property subleasing.
